caption: The drawing consists of three horizontal bands filled with detailed, colorful botanical and bird motifs. Each band features a variety of flowers, leaves, vines, and birds, all intertwined and arranged to fill the space. The flowers are depicted in shades of pink, red, yellow, blue, and purple, with green leaves and brown stems winding through the compositions. Birds, illustrated in shades of pink and brown, perch among the branches and flowers. The background of each band is a light, neutral color, allowing the vivid, multicolored designs to stand out. The overall composition is symmetrical and densely packed, with little empty space within each band, and each band is separated by a clear space from the others. The borders of the bands are straight and define the sections clearly on a plain beige background.
title: Border or Valance
